inspiration.observed_pattern: An ALTER TABLE adds a virtual generated column and explicitly requests ALGORITHM=INSTANT so the schema change remains metadata-only.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a contact-directory migration. A virtual generated ownership key is added with ALGORITHM=INSTANT from email and confirmation fields, and ordered data plus information-schema checks expose both computed values and column metadata. The source procedure, table, identifiers, and account workflow are not copied.

fixture_notes: Confirmed contacts receive a lower-cased ownership key, while an unconfirmed contact receives NULL. The ALTER must preserve existing rows and expose the generated column as VIRTUAL.
determinism_notes: Email values, confirmation flags, generated expression, metadata projection, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE contact_directory (contact_id INT PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR(64) NULL, email_confirmed TINYINT NOT NULL, clean_email VARCHAR(64) NULL)
INSERT INTO contact_directory VALUES (1001, 'Alex.Example@Mail.test', 1, NULL), (1002, 'placeholder@Mail.test', 0, NULL), (1003, 'Casey@Mail.test', 1, 'casey@canonical.test')

steps.sql: ALTER TABLE contact_directory ADD COLUMN owned_key VARCHAR(64) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN email IS NOT NULL AND email_confirmed = 1 THEN COALESCE(clean_email, LOWER(email)) ELSE NULL END) VIRTUAL, ALGORITHM=INSTANT

checks.sql: SELECT contact_id, email, email_confirmed, owned_key FROM contact_directory ORDER BY contact_id
SELECT COLUMN_NAME, EXTRA, IS_NULLABLE FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = 'contact_directory' AND column_name = 'owned_key' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
